d: Georgia Senator Jon Ossoff fires up supporters with a forceful attack on President Donald Trump and Republican Senate candidate Mike Collins, declaring, “10 days until we win!” Ahead of the 2026 US midterm elections, Ossoff accuses Trump of attacking voting rights, raising living costs and cutting healthcare, while highlighting Georgia’s hospital closures, Medicaid expansion battle and rising insurance premiums. He also targets Collins over allegations involving white nationalist and antisemitic propaganda, citing CNN reporting. Ossoff urges supporters to mobilise voters across Georgia,…
